2. Data Center Moratorium

Yes 1363
No 712
Blank _____

Data Center Moratorium
This ordinance would temporarily stop the Town from accepting, processing, reviewing, or approving
applications for new, enlarged, or expanded data centers. It would expire six months after enactment unless
lifted earlier or extended under its stated conditions. It would apply to applications filed on or after November
3rd, 2026.
The stated purpose is to allow the Town time to study potential impacts of data centers and determine whether
additional local zoning and building standards are needed. The moratorium identifies electricity demand, water
supply, wastewater capacity, noise, lighting, traffic, visual character, and municipal finances as subjects for
review.
Town staff, appropriate committees, and outside resources would review existing ordinances and study these
issues. Staff would report findings and recommended ordinance amendments to the Select Board, which would
make the report public and determine whether and when to submit the proposals to the Planning Board for
public hearings and before a Town Meeting.
The moratorium would not permanently prohibit data centers. It excludes equipment incidental to another
business, routine maintenance or equipment replacement that does not expand an existing data center, and
government information technology infrastructure used for governmental purposes. Extensions of no more than
180 days each would require findings that the need for the moratorium continues and reasonable progress is
being made.
No proposals for a data center are under consideration at this time
